name: button
title: Button
description: Starts an action on this page or submits a form.

when: The press changes something on this page: save, send, open a dialog.

instead.when: The press goes to another page.
The action sits inside running text.

guidance.rule: Use danger only to confirm a destructive step.
Label with a verb in sentence case: "Save changes".

builtIn: Pending and disabled states are exposed to assistive technology.
A 44px hit area under coarse pointers without changing the layout.
youProvide: An `aria-label` when the button shows only an icon.

genui.description: A button for an action on this page. Use variant primary for the one main action; danger only to confirm a destructive step. Emits press.

variant.description: `primary` is the one main action of a view; `danger` only confirms a destructive step.

iconBefore.description: Lucide icon name shown before the label ("plus").

iconAfter.description: Lucide icon name shown after the label.

Button.name: suppressHydrationWarning
Button.description:
A React-only flag that suppresses the warning React normally logs when an element's
server-rendered content doesn't match the client render during hydration. See [React
docs](https://react.dev/reference/react-dom/client/hydrateRoot#suppressing-unavoidable-hydration-mismatch-errors).

Button.name: autoFocus
Button.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.

Button.name: id
Button.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).

Button.name: slot
Button.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.

Button.name: aria-controls
Button.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

Button.name: aria-current
Button.description:
Indicates whether this element represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

Button.name: aria-describedby
Button.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

Button.name: aria-details
Button.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.

Button.name: aria-disabled
Button.description: Indicates whether the element is disabled to users of assistive technology.

Button.name: aria-expanded
Button.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

Button.name: aria-haspopup
Button.description:
Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that
can be triggered by an element.

Button.name: aria-label
Button.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

Button.name: aria-labelledby
Button.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

Button.name: aria-pressed
Button.description: Indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

Button.name: onFocus
Button.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.

Button.name: onBlur
Button.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.

Button.name: onKeyDown
Button.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.

Button.name: onKeyUp
Button.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.

Button.name: onClick
Button.description:
**Not recommended – use `onPress` instead.** `onClick` is an alias for `onPress`
provided for compatibility with other libraries. `onPress` provides
additional event details for non-mouse interactions.

Button.name: isDisabled
Button.description: Whether the button is disabled.

Button.name: onPress
Button.description: Handler that is called when the press is released over the target.

Button.name: onPressStart
Button.description: Handler that is called when a press interaction starts.

Button.name: onPressEnd
Button.description:
Handler that is called when a press interaction ends, either
over the target or when the pointer leaves the target.

Button.name: onPressChange
Button.description: Handler that is called when the press state changes.

Button.name: onPressUp
Button.description:
Handler that is called when a press is released over the target, regardless of
whether it started on the target or not.

Button.name: onFocusChange
Button.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.

Button.name: type
Button.description: The behavior of the button when used in an HTML form.

Button.name: preventFocusOnPress
Button.description:
Whether to prevent focus from moving to the button when pressing it.

Caution, this can make the button inaccessible and should only be used when alternative
keyboard interaction is provided, such as ComboBox's MenuTrigger or a NumberField's
increment/decrement control.

Button.name: form
Button.description:
The `<form>` element to associate the button with.
The value of this attribute must be the id of a `<form>` in the same document.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/button#form).

Button.name: formAction
Button.description:
The URL that processes the information submitted by the button.
Overrides the action attribute of the button's form owner.

Button.name: formEncType
Button.description: Indicates how to encode the form data that is submitted.

Button.name: formMethod
Button.description: Indicates the HTTP method used to submit the form.

Button.name: formNoValidate
Button.description: Indicates that the form is not to be validated when it is submitted.

Button.name: formTarget
Button.description: Overrides the target attribute of the button's form owner.

Button.name: name
Button.description: Submitted as a pair with the button's value as part of the form data.

Button.name: value
Button.description: The value associated with the button's name when it's submitted with the form data.

Button.name: excludeFromTabOrder
Button.description:
Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order. If true,
the element will not be focusable via the keyboard by tabbing. This should
be avoided except in rare scenarios where an alternative means of accessing
the element or its functionality via the keyboard is available.

Button.name: isPending
Button.description:
Whether the button is in a pending state. This disables press and hover events
while retaining focusability, and announces the pending state to screen readers.

Button.name: onHoverStart
Button.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction starts.

Button.name: onHoverEnd
Button.description: Handler that is called when a hover interaction ends.

Button.name: onHoverChange
Button.description: Handler that is called when the hover state changes.

Button.name: render
Button.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.

Button.name: variant
Button.description: `primary` is the one main action of a view; `danger` only confirms a destructive step.

Button.name: iconBefore
Button.description: Lucide icon name shown before the label ("plus").

Button.name: iconAfter
Button.description: Lucide icon name shown after the label.
